_comment: Known-stale sim/ evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py compares each experiment's NEWEST record's committed per-point netlist snapshots against the design/ netlist that record names as its own provenance; a record produced against a superseded DUT is stale evidence, and stale evidence fails ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades exactly one such failure to a loud note: it names the exact record, the exact DUT netlist, and the exact stale device signature digest. It SELF-EXPIRES two ways -- if the record is re-run the digest no longer matches, and if a NEWER record is appended to the experiment this entry stops matching any check the checker runs. Either way CI fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue; waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call. This is the sim/ counterpart of layout/evidence-freshness-waivers.json.

waivers.reason: closed-loop-psrr-pex 2026-09-05 record: extracted-layout DUT on the pre-trim geometry. #272 delivered the missing precondition -- layout/bandgap_core now draws #229's 255-unit trim ladder at code 128, DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.pex.spice is re-extracted from it -- but the re-run itself is deferred to #275, which has to settle the corner-grid harness (this repo's run_pvt_sweep.sh shell loops are not runnable on the dispatch hosts) and the mask-option-vs-D2 question first. Delete this entry when that re-run lands. Hash rebased by #275: D2 now resolves the metal-option trim ladder before comparing (the behavioural RS0-RS7 straps and the XXTRIM call model a mask option, not silicon, and are excluded from the DUT signature -- the same convention layout/lvs_reference.py's convert_with_metal_options applies to the LVS reference), so these snapshots' recorded signature changed from 88fbebb94b0d... to fc1118a5a72f... with no change to the snapshots themselves. The staleness being waived is unchanged: these records still ran against the pre-trim DUT.
